subtitle: Applied Data Science
courseType:
Mathematics and Science Program

educationalGoal: Acquire practical skills for applying typical machine learning algorithms such as regression, classification, dimensionality reduction, and clustering using the scikit-learn library.
advice: In this course, you will learn data analysis methods using various machine learning algorithms. (In the interest of time, the following topics will NOT be covered: deep learning, anomaly detection, and time series analysis.) The lectures will mostly follows the textbook "Introduction to Machine Learning with Python", starting with a general introduction to machine learning followed by supervised learning (regression and classification) and unsupervised learning (dimensionality reduction and clustering). The scikit-learn library, which is used throughout the course, covers most of the machine learning tasks (except for visualization) from data preprocessing through model definition and training to evaluation. Using its sophisticated interface, you can do a lot of task just by writing a few lines of code. By taking this course, you are expected to acquire practical skills for applying machine learning to real-world problems.
books: Japanese translation of Andreas Muller and Sarah Guido, "Introduction to Machine Learning with Python" (O'Reilly, 2016).
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge about Python programming: if statements, for loops, functions, data structures such as lists and dictionaries, and method invocations on objects.

activityGoals.body: Can explain overfitting and underfitting in supervised learning.
Can train and use typical regression models.
Can train and use typical classification models.
Can use typical clustering and dimensionality reduction algorithms.
Can identify and preprocess features for target problems.
Can evaluate and tune supervised learning models.
